# 🏎️ NeuralOps v1.3.4: Serving Primitives & KV Cache Optimization

## 🌟 Highlights
- **Paged KV Cache Management**: Prototype non-contiguous page allocation reducing VRAM fragmentation.
- **Speculative Decoding Engine**: Initial draft token verification pipelines for accelerated generation.
- **Gradient Verification**: Expanded forward/backward gradient check coverage across attention families.

## 📦 Installation

